title: Quantum recovery from finitely many sharp questions
description: Manuscript by Seth Douglas (seth.douglas@gmail.com) on quantitative recovery from finitely many calibrated sharp binary observables, including complete Appendix A and supplementary verification code. The manuscript is CC-BY-4.0; original code and software documentation are MIT-licensed. LICENSE.md specifies the separate file scopes. Lean coverage is partial: calibrated projections imply finite-word operator-norm stability; no numbered recovery theorem is fully formalized. Language models assisted exploration and checking; the author retains responsibility for the claims.
